title: coax shows a decade notice after every update when decade gives it no pane
body:
coax joins decade when `DECADE_SOCKET` is set (`connect_env` in `src/report.rs`) and claims the pane named by `DECADE_PANE`. After every change to the transcript, `report_to_decade` in `src/app.rs` sends decade an `agent` update through `Reporter::send`. `App::decade` shows each `Error` from decade as a `Notice` entry reading "decade: <reason>".

A coax started from inside another decade pane inherits that pane's variables. This happens when coax runs in a tmux session started by an agent in a decade pane. decade refuses the claim with "pane terminal is occupied by coax". coax still sends an `agent` update after each change, and decade answers each one with "agent is for the agent in a pane, and this client claimed none". In a trial run, one prompt and one tool call put that notice in the transcript seven times, between every entry.

`report_to_decade` sends whenever a `Reporter` exists and never reads `decade_pane`. `decade_pane` also stood for the connection. `Some(String::new())` meant connected with no pane, and `App::click_link` checked only whether it was `None`.

## Open

- Whether coax should show the refusal once, or not at all.
close_reason: 1020ca6 on dev. The note on this issue describes the fix. The body's open question was not settled: decade's refusal still shows once.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4c7bb0a4
notes.text: The fix splits the field in two. `App::decade` says coax holds a connection, and `App::click_link` checks it. `App::decade_pane` holds only the pane a `Welcome` gave, and `None` otherwise. `report_to_decade` returns before sending while `decade_pane` is `None`. So coax keeps the connection for `show` and sends no `agent` update without a pane. The refusal itself still shows once, which leaves the open question.
